title: Grand Synagogue of Tunis

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the western end of the named lot near the Avenue de la Liberté approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap synagogue parcel and independently mapped Avenue de la Liberté.
mapIdentity.scope: The named native place-of-worship parcel, its independent avenue line and the historic address fix the western façade and the overall site. The building inset and all individual bay positions are estimates.

note: The documented square central hall, twelve straight-sided drum openings, stepped gable and dome, broad square porch pillars and flanking pavilions define the reconstructed exterior.
